semantic_acceptance.layout: One, two, three, or more sheets are accepted; sheet names and fixed row numbers are not scored.
semantic_acceptance.paired_difference: Correct reported differences receive content credit. Formula-linked differences separately earn the source-change and chart-link criterion.
semantic_acceptance.method: A numerically correct p-value must also be identified as paired and two-sided.
semantic_acceptance.chart_binding: Accept a direct paired-difference series or a formula-linked helper series covering all ten pairs.
semantic_acceptance.source_gate: The ten ordered source pairs remain protected; inclusion flags were not requested and are not scored.

perturbations.name: paired_observation
perturbations.expected_effect: the paired difference and its chart-linked value both increase by 0.5
